brief_summary: Investigation into Copper Finch reveals a high-value Scale tier account in a renewal lifecycle stage, exhibiting concerning downward trends in feature adoption and active user counts. While session frequency is increasing, an open medium-severity workflow support case with negative sentiment suggests friction in user experience. Recovery efforts should focus on re-engaging users with core features via email, respecting the existing consent for recovery outreach.

observations.claim: Feature adoption has decreased from 41.04% to 29.08% over the last 30 days.
Active user count has dropped from 141 to 120 in the last 30 days.
There is an open medium-severity workflow support case with negative sentiment (-0.267).
Session frequency per user has increased from 3.77 to 4.85.

hypotheses.statement: Declining feature adoption is driving the reduction in active users.
hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence_needed: Evidence showing feature adoption is stable while active users decline, or evidence that seat utilisation is the primary driver of user drop-off.

hypotheses.statement: The open workflow support case is contributing to user frustration and potential churn risk.
hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence_needed: Evidence that the support case is unrelated to core product value or that sentiment improves without intervention.

unknowns: Specific cause for the decline in feature adoption
Impact of the open support case on renewal probability

designer_handoff.design_challenge: Create a Signal Garden recovery experience that addresses declining feature adoption and active user counts, while acknowledging recent workflow friction, delivered via email.
priority_outcomes: Stabilize or increase active user count
non_negotiables: Must use email as the primary communication channel
Must address the decline in feature adoption
Must not ignore the open support case sentiment
success_signals: Resolution of open support case with positive sentiment
